MailDwarf01: You hear it... deep in the stone...^I see curious human.^Take this. Stone does not lie.^— Dwarf
MailDwarf02: Human begins to understand the mines.^Small explosions help... yes.^Do not die down there.^— Dwarf
MailDwarf03: Crystals speak to those who listen.^Mushrooms grow where no one walks.^You are learning.^— Dwarf
MailDwarf04: The caves feel more real now.^Geodes hold ancient secrets.^Do not trust the silence of stone.^— From Below
MailDwarf05: Darkness is not empty.^It is full of will...^And you begin to hear it.^— From Below
MailDwarf06: Light and shadow fight in the depths.^Gold is no longer rare to you.^This is good... and dangerous.^— From Below
MailDwarf07: The walls tremble as you pass.^Explosions are language now.^You speak well.^— From Below
MailDwarf08: Fire is born inside hot stone.^Iridium is not for weak hands.^You are no longer weak.^— Deep
MailDwarf09: Life and death mixed in bottles.^The caves recognize you now.^This cannot be undone.^— Deep
MailDwarf10: You are no longer a visitor of the mines.^You belong to them.^And the mines belong to you.^— Deep
